issues.explanation: Julian's eyes were established as green, and Leo has "Julian's exact green eyes". Episode 8 says both have gray eyes.
issues.suggested_fix: Change "exact gray of his own" to "exact green of his own".

issues.explanation: Julian's 2018 hospital stay beside Frank Bell was at St. Luke's in Episode 7. Episode 8 places it at St. Margaret's.
Nora said the wedding was six years ago in Episode 4. Episode 8 says seven years ago.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the timeframe consistent: change Episode 8 to "six years ago" or revise the Episode 4 line.

issues.explanation: Leo was 5 in Episode 7 and is 7 in Episode 8, with no time jump shown. He was 6 in Episodes 3 to 6.
issues.suggested_fix: Make Leo 5 or 6 in Episode 8 and change the Nora line to "a six-year-old".

issues.explanation: Julian is 32 in Episode 8, but he was 34 in Episode 7, 36 in Episode 6 and 33 in Episodes 1 and 2.
issues.suggested_fix: Set Julian's age to one consistent value across the episodes.

issues.explanation: Nora is 29 in Episode 8, but she was 32 in Episodes 5 to 7, with no time jump shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Set Nora's age to 32, or to whichever single age the series settles on.

issues.explanation: Julian said he waited three hours at the church, and in Episode 4 he said he received a message that Nora had called it off. Episode 8 says he woke in a hospital with three weeks of amnesia around that time, so he could not have been at the church.
issues.suggested_fix: Explain how Julian could remember waiting at the church despite the amnesia, or make the amnesia begin after the wedding date.
